MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 4

2. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 5
   C. 26
   D. 25

3. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 22
   C. 122
   D. 11

4. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 2
   C. 48
   D. 49

5. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 50
   C. 49
   D. 7

6. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 10

7. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 1
   C. 73
   D. 72

8. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 19
   C. 23
   D. 17

9. Solve for x: x + 7 = 13. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 13
   C. 7
   D. 6

10. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 170
   C. 13
   D. 169

11. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 18
   C. 82
   D. 81

12. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 156
   C. 144
   D. 48

13. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 2.5
   B. 0.205
   C. 0.025
   D. 0.25

14. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 12
   C. 32
   D. 4

15. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 36
   C. 12
   D. 24

16. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 28
   B. 11
   C. 29
   D. 3

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
